title: QA: close out the 14 open qa-run records of the e4e5c6e3 wave — supersede sweep, four-way FAIL disposition, extraction
body:
Maintainer authorization (2026-08-18, PM chat, skills-seat session `session_01Rn7aaamsR99FXRqLcpL99q`, direct-dispatch channel): 「同意你的落地动作」, approving the QA-loop landing plan whose item 1 is this card: process the existing stock of open `qa-run` records.

**Coordination note**: these records belong to the #9296 wave (`pm:epic`, owning session named on that card). This close-out executes under the maintainer authorization above, announced by comment on #9296 — it implements that card's own standing rule ("defects extract into their own cards, which is the PM's close-out duty"), it does not re-run or re-judge any round.

## Scope

The 14 open `qa-run` issues as of 2026-08-18: #9330 #9332 #9333 #9334 #9336 #9337 #9338 #9351 #9352 #9353 #9401 #9417 #9453 #9467.

## Procedure per record

1. **Supersede check first** (abandoned R3 area runs: #9330 #9332 #9333 #9336 #9337 #9338 #9351 #9352 #9353): the tier runs (#9401 tier1-pinned, #9417/#9453/#9467 tier2 P0/P1-unpinned) re-covered most of their ground. **Verify overlap per record, do not assume**: an area run's consulted items that are P2-unpinned were NOT re-covered by any tier run (Tier-3 was deferred by decision) — any verdict a tier run did not re-derive must be carried forward into the close-out comment, not silently dropped. Then close as not_planned with a `Superseded-by: #<tier-run>` line naming what carried each verdict forward.
2. **Four-way FAIL disposition** (completed runs: #9334 R1-P0, #9417, #9453, #9467, and any non-superseded FAIL from step 1): classify each FAIL on the record's own evidence — (a) product defect → file an independent bug card (dup-check first; fix-landing repo per file-at-destination — console/UI defects go to objectstack-ai/objectui); (b) assertion/spec defect → file a test-fix card in the repo owning the spec; (c) stale spec → file a re-point card; (d) invalid pairing / environment → record as blocked in the close-out comment, no card.
3. **Extracted cards**: filed WITHOUT pm labels and WITHOUT assignee (they enter normal triage first-touch), body carries a greppable `QA-source: #<run> · <area.item> · <clause>` line. Note #9351 already extracted #9362 — link, don't duplicate.
4. **PARTIAL gaps**: do NOT file cards (three security-priority cards are already filed by the PM; the rest are parked on #9296 by the PM). Reference the parking comment.
5. **Security findings**: per the maintainer disclosure ruling (recorded on #9387 and in #9296's header): existence only, never a reproduction, anywhere on GitHub.
6. **Close-out comment shape** on every record before closing, machine-greppable: `Extracted: #a #b …` / `Carried-forward: <verdicts>` / `Parked-on: #9296` / `Superseded-by: #N` (whichever apply), then close (completed for extracted runs, not_planned for superseded ones).

## Constraints

- GitHub issue operations only — no repo files, no code, no PRs.
- Every new card dup-checked before filing (keyword + error-string searches).
- Report back: per-record disposition table + list of filed cards.
